$comment: Build dependencies (vcpkg manifest mode). README.md, Setup. sdl2: X11 and Wayland video (SDL picks; runtime/src/app/sdl_gl.cpp creates the GLES contexts through EGL on either). Both backends load their system libraries at run time; building the wayland feature needs libwayland-dev (wayland-scanner from libwayland-bin), libxkbcommon-dev and libegl-dev, and uses libdecor-0-dev when present (SDL bundles the protocol XML: no wayland-protocols package). boost-icl + boost-variant: the Boost headers dynarmic includes (boost-headers is only the umbrella CMake package). egl-registry / opengl-registry: headers only; libEGL / libGLESv2 come from the system (Mesa). dynarmic and IJG libjpeg 9 are not in vcpkg: CMake FetchContent (cmake/deps.cmake). Later, for the Windows runner: angle (platform windows). sqlite3 is pinned to 3.45.1 (overrides), the version of Ubuntu 24.04's libsqlite3 the server used before vcpkg: the served master (server/src/cdn/served_master.cpp make_served_master: a VACUUMed copy) is byte-for-byte that SQLite's output, its SHA-1 feeds the CDN's version ids, and a pre-downloaded phone (SOA_PHONE) only skips the data check while those ids match. Its compile options are Ubuntu's too (cmake/vcpkg-triplets/x64-linux.cmake: SQLITE_SECURE_DELETE zeroes freed space in the VACUUMed file). litehtml (+ gumbo; our overlay port cmake/vcpkg-ports/litehtml, from the Dragalia Lost project: two patches) and stb (stb_truetype, stb_image, stb_image_write; headers): the web view's page renderer (webview/, docs/webview.md).
